summary: Shoshone County peak with a 1920s log cabin, a 1935 pole platform and a 1939 L-4 tower, all destroyed by 1969; no staffing history given.

facts.status_note: Both main pages say destroyed in 1969. Firelookout.com says ruins of the west-summit platform were still there in the 1980s.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Hike-In.

events.note: Log cabin with cupola. The sources give only the 1920s, so 1920 marks the start of that decade.
48-foot pole platform on the west summit. Firelookout.com says its ruins were still there in the 1980s.
L-4 tower on the east summit.
Both main pages date the destruction to 1969.

notes_for_editor: Record coordinate conflict: the association list gives 47.27155, -115.71380, which matches our record; the Idaho Fire Lookouts point in the record is about 816 m away and was not verified on a page read here. 1920 is a placeholder for the 1920s. The Hike-In tag is recorded as drive_up false. Two WebSearch queries found nothing further.
